parameters.content:
PLACEHOLDER / INACTIVE
Self-Improvement Loop V1 design only.
States: CANDIDATE_RECEIVED → PROPOSAL_VALIDATED → AUTO_AUTHORIZED → INDEPENDENT_REVIEW → READY_FOR_HUMAN_PROMOTION
Failure routes: POLICY_REJECTED, PATCH_REJECTED, VALIDATION_FAILED, REVIEW_FAILED, REPAIR_LIMIT_REACHED → FAILED_FROZEN
Schemas: improvement_candidate.schema.json, implementation_proposal.schema.json, execution_result.schema.json, review_result.schema.json, learning_record.schema.json
Implementer: srl-implementer-agent
Reviewer: srl-independent-reviewer-agent (must differ)
No credentials. No HTTP. No AI nodes. No webhooks. No paid API execution.
Human promotion gate required before merge.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { stage: 'candidate intake', state: 'CANDIDATE_RECEIVED', schema_ref: 'specs/self_improvement/v1/improvement_candidate.schema.json' } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'candidate schema validation', state: 'RESEARCH_VALIDATED', failure_route: 'POLICY_REJECTED' } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'research-agent dispatch', agent: 'srl-research-agent', mode: 'offline_fixture_only' } }];

return [{ json: { stage: 'implementation-proposal validation', schema_ref: 'specs/self_improvement/v1/implementation_proposal.schema.json', state: 'PROPOSAL_VALIDATED', failure_route: 'POLICY_REJECTED' } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'risk classification', state: 'RISK_CLASSIFIED', levels: ['LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH','PROHIBITED'] } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'LOW-risk auto-authorization', state: 'AUTO_AUTHORIZED', auto_authorize: 'LOW', otherwise: 'DECISION_REQUIRED' } }];

return [{ json: { stage: 'local-worker dispatch', interface_contract: { request: { proposal: 'implementation_proposal', operation: 'execute|validate-proposal|finalize', correlation_id: 'string' }, response: { status: 'PASS|FAIL', execution_result: 'object|null', error: 'string|null' } }, endpoint: 'INTERFACE_ONLY_NO_ACTIVE_ENDPOINT', credential_ref: 'PLACEHOLDER_LOCAL_WORKER_CREDENTIAL' } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'execution-result validation', schema_ref: 'specs/self_improvement/v1/execution_result.schema.json', failure_route: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' } }];

return [{ json: { stage: 'independent-review-agent dispatch', reviewer: 'srl-independent-reviewer-agent', implementer: 'srl-implementer-agent', state: 'INDEPENDENT_REVIEW', independent_from_implementer: true } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'review-result validation', schema_ref: 'specs/self_improvement/v1/review_result.schema.json', failure_route: 'REVIEW_FAILED', terminal_failure: 'FAILED_FROZEN' } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'finalization dispatch', operation: 'finalize', requires_review_pass: true } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'learning-record persistence', schema_ref: 'specs/self_improvement/v1/learning_record.schema.json', store: 'sqlite_explicit_path' } }];
return [{ json: { stage: 'human notification', human promotion: true, final_state: 'READY_FOR_HUMAN_PROMOTION', push: false, merge: false } }];
